build_game_master: build a GameMaster prefab that handles matrix game decisions with configurable payoff functions and scenes
configure_default_scenes: configure default Oedipus Rex simulation scenes with decision-type action specs for given participant names
action_to_scores: map a joint action dictionary to per-player float scores using the default coordination game scoring logic
scores_to_observation: convert per-player score dictionaries into string observations describing whether each player was persuaded or learned the truth
get_class_name: get the class name string from any Python object for use as a component key
